result.summary: The page is largely well-designed and functional, but a few visual issues stand out: horizontally scrollable rows (category chips and 'Fastest near you' cards) are cut off at the right edge without clear scroll affordance, and one restaurant name is truncated without ellipsis handling.

issues.description: The category filter chips row ('All', 'Pizza', 'Sushi', 'Burgers', 'Healthy') is cut off at the right edge with a partially visible chip, giving no clear visual cue that the row is horizontally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle fade/gradient mask or scroll indicator on the right edge to signal that more categories are available via horizontal scrolling.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the third card ('Trattoria Piccol...') is clipped at the right edge and its name is truncated mid-word without an ellipsis, which looks broken.
issues.suggestion: Apply proper text truncation with an ellipsis ('Trattoria Piccol…') and consider a right-edge fade to indicate the carousel continues.

issues.description: The '-100%' discount badge on the bottom pizza card is ambiguous and could be confusing (a 100% discount implies the item is free, which may be a data/promo error).
issues.suggestion: Verify the promotion data; if intended, clarify the offer (e.g., 'Free item' or '100% off first order') to avoid user confusion.
